voice.instruct: female, young adult, moderate pitch, american accent

scenes.say: Kubernetes never runs your container on its own.
scenes.visual: Terminal types 'kubectl run web --image=nginx' from frame 0; the 'web' container card pops in on 'container'.

scenes.say: It wraps it in a pod.
scenes.visual: A rounded Pod box springs open around the container on 'pod', tag 'Pod' on its corner.

scenes.say: Containers in a pod share one IP address and storage.
scenes.caption: Containers in a pod share one IP address and storage.
scenes.visual: Pod widens, a 'logger' sidecar slides in on 'containers'; an IP badge pops on 'IP'; a volume appears on 'storage' with packets flowing on a dashed line.

scenes.say: The scheduler places each pod on a node.
scenes.visual: Two node boxes pop in; the pod shrinks and flies into Node 2 on 'places'.

scenes.say: If it crashes, a deployment starts a fresh one.
scenes.visual: Pod turns red with an X on 'crashes' and falls away; a fresh pod pops into Node 1 with a green check on 'fresh'.
